events.headline: Ukraine launched one of its largest drone barrages of 2026 at Moscow on Oct 5, forcing temporary closure of Vnukovo, Domodedovo and Zhukovsky airports; Russia's MoD said 61 UAVs were shot down region-wide, with a fire reported at a chemical plant in Tula region, underscoring continued escalation risk in the war (day ~1,411)

China's one-year suspension of its October-2025 rare-earth/lithium-battery export controls (agreed at the Trump-Xi summit) has been confirmed extended to January 10, 2027, averting a near-term critical-minerals supply shock though the underlying US-China dispute over chokepoints remains unresolved

Marvell held its Investor Day in New York on Oct 6 highlighting AI-infrastructure/custom-silicon demand, while Micron's confirmed $9.6B (JPY1.5T) Hiroshima HBM fab build-out and continued industry forecasts of AI/data-center-driven semiconductor growth kept chip and memory names in focus ahead of mid-October earnings season

Minutes from the Fed's Sept 16 FOMC meeting (where it hiked to 3.75%-4.00% amid inflation the Chair called 'too high for too long') are due Oct 7; with core PCE still running near 3.6% and prediction markets pricing roughly even odds on the Oct 27-28 decision, policy remains in a restrictive, data-dependent holding pattern
